verdict.rationale: Cooley GO provides free, public document generators and templates covering incorporation packages (Certificate of Incorporation, Bylaws, Restricted Stock Purchase Agreement, 83(b) elections), YC SAFE generators (US/UK/Singapore), Series Seed financing packages, and NDAs (including UK mutual form), all accessible without being a paying client, corroborated by independent community mention as a well-known startup resource. Missing for 10: no explicit statement confirming zero account/signup requirement or client-gating details, and no hands-on generator walkthrough beyond page descriptions.
